evals.prompt: VCB weekly chart: price is 61.9 after trading down to 59.8. SMA20W=61.25, SMA50W=61.35, SMA100W=60.60. Prior resistance and breakout shelf were around 60.5-62. evals.expected_output: Treats 61.7 as a representative point inside a 60.5-62 zone; computes a very tight weekly MA cluster; uses horizontal pivot and role reversal; prioritizes weekly close over wick; provides score, confirmation, invalidation, verdict, and confidence.

evals.prompt: A stock remains above rising monthly structural demand, but the daily chart is oversold after a sharp selloff. Weekly price is testing former resistance on lower volume, while SOS and LPS are not yet confirmed. Give the multi-timeframe verdict and entry quality.
